turns.text: It's not always easy, but I do think we have more control than we admit.
turns.zh: 这并不总是容易，但我确实觉得我们拥有的控制力比我们承认的要多。

turns.text: I almost wanted to just roll my eyes.
turns.zh: 我差点就想直接翻白眼了。

turns.text: I was like, eye roll, okay.
turns.zh: 我当时就是那种，翻白眼，好吧。

turns.text: I had to really stop myself from just oh, it's just so simple.
turns.zh: 我真的得使劲忍住，才没说出「哦，就这么简单」。

turns.text: Maybe that was a a bit of a hot take on her end because it was over simplifying it, right?
turns.zh: 也许她那个说法有点太想当然了，因为那确实是把事情过度简化了，对吧？

turns.text: Just throw your phone in the ocean.
turns.zh: 直接把手机扔海里得了。
